summary: A post-apocalyptic civilization-building campaign game where players explore a modular map, recruit survivors, and build up tech trees and factories using a deck/bag-building resource engine across five interconnected scenarios. It's a meaty, asymmetric euro from the Aporta Games team (Kristian Amundsen Østby and Eilif Svensson) that rewards efficient engine optimization over multiple linked plays.
praised: Excellent campaign structure with real permanent unlocks
criticised: Steep learning curve, especially early scenarios

interaction.detail: Each player builds up their own tribe and factory boards independently with no fighting or direct attacks. Interaction happens mainly through open drafting of shared offers (survivors, sites, technologies), where taking an option denies it to opponents.

scoring.how_you_win: Across the campaign's rounds, explore the map, build settlements and factories, and climb the technology tracks; the player with the highest combined VP from territory, tech and citizens at the end wins.
scoring.score_note: endgame VP tally; varies with tech/pop progress
